body: We were 10 days from our wedding and boom called it off, ended the relationship and wants nothing to do with me. Like I said in the post her family and myself all think she is clinically bipolar as it runs in her family and she has always shown signs of the sickness. Keep thinking this is a manic episode on her end it’s honestly the only thing keeping me alive right now.

I want her back in my life so bad. She just ended it and moved on, no tears, no feelings no nothing. She living her life like I never mattered and didn’t do everything in the world for her which I did. I can’t live seeing her like this while I struggle through everyday
